data.summary: Erdgas Beispieltal GmbH informs Johanna Beispielacker that gas prices will rise from 1 January 2027: the unit price (Arbeitspreis) increases from 9.84 ct/kWh to 11.12 ct/kWh, and the monthly advance payment (Abschlag) rises from €104.00 to €118.00.
data.explanation: Your gas supplier is raising its prices and your monthly advance payment, starting 1 January 2027. Because of this increase, you have a special right to cancel the contract without the usual notice period — the app will show you until when you can do this. If you do nothing, the new prices and the higher advance payment of €118.00 per month will simply take effect automatically. If you want to switch supplier, you should compare offers and send your cancellation before the deadline shown.
